scenario: I paid my share of the bill after eating dinner with friends.
topic_summary: Fair payment in group dining situations
sentences: The fairness was undermined by the action because the full payment was not covered by those friends.
The trust was diminished by their behavior because the financial responsibility was neglected by the group.
The resentment was created by the process because the total bill was not divided evenly by those attending.
The obligation was fulfilled by them because the share was paid by the participant.
The harmony was disrupted by their choice because the difference was left unpaid by some attendees.
